text:
Connor O'Brien: :mega: Heads up #general — **In-console Usage Insights (BETA)** is now available behind a feature flag.

What it is: cost + usage breakdowns by **API route + model** (tokens in/out, cache hit/miss, retries/fallbacks, latency), plus an early **Top cost drivers / What changed** view.

Who it’s for: anyone who’s been asking “why did our spend spike?” or needs route-level chargeback / finance exports.

How to get access:
• Beta is allowlist-only right now. Request enablement via **INT-9132** (Internal Support) or DM me + @Evan Scott with the workspace + owner.
• For private/VPC workspaces: please loop @Naomi Feldman before we enable.

Where to send feedback / bugs:
• Product feedback + “this is confusing” → reply in this thread and tag @Marissa Cole / @Paula Mendes
• Bug reports / discrepancies vs invoice → open a Support ticket and tag **Usage Insights Beta** (or DM @Dev Patel if you’re not sure where it belongs)
• Perf issues/timeouts → tag @Dylan Brooks / @Allison Grant with time range + workspace + screenshot

Links:
• Linear initiative: PM-1427
• Docs draft: (WIP) /docs/console/usage-insights (coming soon)

Known limitations (beta):
• Some totals may lag up to ~2–3h depending on ingestion/aggregation
• Route normalization is still being hardened for OpenAI-compat endpoints
• Exports are CSV only; shareable links are limited to same-workspace viewers

Please share any sharp edges. We’re trying to get this to “finance-grade” correctness before broader rollout. :thumbsup:

Marissa Cole: Thanks Connor. Adding: we’re especially looking for feedback on terminology (route vs endpoint), and whether the driver explanations feel actionable vs just “data”.

Dylan Brooks: +1 and if you hit the dreaded blank table: grab the **Data freshness** banner state + time range. That’ll help us triage “no data yet” vs query issue.

Alex Martinez: For folks testing: if you find a metric label/toolip that’s confusing, drop it here. We have a running list of copy tweaks we can ship quickly.

Markus Klein: We’ve got 3 beta customers already lined up asking for **weekly what-changed** summaries + CSV for finance. If anyone has a similar internal use case, would love to hear it.

Dev Patel: Support note: if you see “totals don’t match invoice” please include:
1) workspace + billing period
2) screenshot of the totals row
3) whether you had fallbacks/retries visible in the driver panel
We’re tracking these closely.

Paula Mendes: Also: if you request enablement, please tell us if you need **project-level** visibility vs workspace-level only. It affects how we validate the RBAC settings.

Nadia Rahman: Quick callout: retries are attributed as separate attempts right now (so they’ll show up as additional tokens/cost). That’s intended, but we’re tuning the copy so it’s clearer.

Allison Grant: Perf guardrail: 30-day ranges can be slow in some workspaces. If you need a long window, try 7d first while we finish query tuning.

Evan Scott: If you DM for enablement, send the workspace slug + desired environment (prod/staging). Some folks want this on staging first.

Naomi Feldman: Re: private/VPC — export auditing is on by default, but please make sure you’ve got the right roles assigned before enabling. Happy to sanity check.

Elliot Price: Docs page is landing this week. If you have screenshots you’re willing to share (no customer identifiers), send them my way for the help center article.

Connor O'Brien: :thumbsup: keep the feedback coming. We’ll do a quick beta update in #general next week with top issues + fixes shipped.
